packageRules.description: Modules the build patches in vendor/, through this repository's patches or sonic-mgmt-common's patches/apply.sh. A bump has to refresh the patch, so it opens on its own, and only on dashboard approval. A security update still opens, on its own (see vulnerabilityAlerts above, which repeats this list), and the patched-module label keeps the preset from labeling it automerge.
prBodyNotes: The build patches this module in `vendor/`, through this repository's `patches/` or sonic-mgmt-common's `patches/apply.sh`. A patch that still applies may no longer be correct for the new version, so check each one against it. This update is never labeled `automerge`.
